item.title: Launching Here Soon, First Batch Of Made-In-Malaysia GWM Wey G9 Exported To Thailand
item.description: GWM Malaysia will be launching the locally-assembled (CKD) GWM Wey G9 MPV here on 29 January 2026. However, prior to that, the first shipment of the Wey G9 exported to Thailand has safely arrived on the shores of our northern neighbours. No time was wasted by GWM Malaysia as the pioneering batch was loaded for shipment shortly after CKD units begun rolling off the assembly lines at the EP Manufacturing (EPMB) plant in Malacca, GWM Malaysia’s CKD partner.
